title: This 1TB cloud storage plan is just $39.99 for lifetime access
excerpt: Store, sync, and share from unlimited devices.
content_html:
TL;DR: Pay $39.99 once for 1TB of LifetimeCloud storage for life, with zero-knowledge AES-256 encryption, unlimited-device access, file history, and family sharing.

Credit: LifetimeCloud

$39.99
$199 Save $159.01

Cloud storage is useful. But paying for it month after month can add up. LifetimeCloud gives you 1TB of encrypted cloud storage for life for a one-time $39.99 payment (reg. $199), with no monthly or annual renewal fees.

The plan gives you one central place for photos, videos, documents, and other files. Everything works through your browser, so there’s no software to install or maintain. You can log in from unlimited computers and phones, and your files stay synced across your devices.

Privacy is also a major part of the package. LifetimeCloud uses zero-knowledge AES-256 encryption, which means files are encrypted before they leave your device. They’re unreadable to anyone but you — including LifetimeCloud itself. LifetimeCloud hosts data in Italy under EU and GDPR protections.

The 1TB plan supports an unlimited number of uploads, although individual files are capped at 1.5GB. You also get one year of file version history, a built-in file editor, and straightforward file and folder sharing.

Family sharing supports up to five members, so you can share the plan across your household.

Updates and security improvements are included, and you can access LifetimeCloud through Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox.

For anyone who wants plenty of private cloud space without adding another recurring payment to the calendar, this is a solid option.
